'''Tvorog''' is a Russian [[Cookbook:Cheese|cheese]].

==Ingredients==
* 1 part cultured [[Cookbook:Buttermilk|buttermilk]]
* 2 parts [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]]

==Procedure==
# Mix milk and buttermilk in a pot, and cover with a lid.
# Let stand for 1–2 days, until the mixture thickens to a consistency of thin yogurt.
# Heat mixture gently, without letting it [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]], until the whey separates from the curds.
# Pour out through [[Cookbook:Cheesecloth|cheese cloth]].
# For a drier tvorog, hang it up for 1–12 hours to let it drain.

== See also ==

* [[Cookbook:Sirniki|Sirniki]]
